subject.title: Rename i18n locale codes from region-based (zh-CN/zh-TW) to script-based (zh-Hans/zh-Hant)

question: Should OpenClaw make `zh-Hans` and `zh-Hant` the canonical Chinese locale IDs across Control UI, CLI wizard, docs publishing, saved browser preferences, and app locale mappings?
rationale: The rename is technically reasonable, but it changes shipped public locale identifiers, documented CLI environment values, and persisted browser preferences, so automation should not choose the migration and alias policy without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve coordinated script-code migration
options.body: Make `zh-Hans` and `zh-Hant` canonical and require one migration PR that updates runtime, docs, generated artifacts, tests, app mappings, and old-value handling together.

options.title: Keep region-code public IDs
options.body: Leave `zh-CN` and `zh-TW` as OpenClaw's public runtime and CLI IDs while accepting script-form input only as aliases that resolve to the existing IDs.

options.title: Split docs metadata from runtime IDs
options.body: Keep runtime and CLI IDs unchanged while limiting script-based naming to docs publish metadata and navigation internals.

recommendation.title: Approve coordinated script-code migration
recommendation.body: Make `zh-Hans` and `zh-Hant` canonical and require one migration PR that updates runtime, docs, generated artifacts, tests, app mappings, and old-value handling together.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses public setup behavior, docs, and migration policy, and steipete is the strongest available routing owner from related CLI onboarding i18n history.
